tempo_density_cut_rate.guidance: Fast tempo: dense fields or many elements, frequent cuts and an urgent rhythm.

palette_warmth_consonance_symmetry.guidance: Cool, austere palette with one sharp accent, asymmetric composition and dissonant harmony.

scale_contrast_camera.guidance: Measured framing: medium scale, moderate contrast and one deliberate camera move.

technical_risk_budget.guidance: Conservative risk: build on a technique the crew can execute reliably.

frustration_scope_polish_weight.guidance: Shrink scope: one rendering idea and at most 4 techniques; spend the saved effort on clean, refined polish.
